rows.source:
b = (lambda: None).__builtins__
key = "__name__"
saved = b[key]
g = {}
exec('def read(): return __name__', g)
b[key] = 42
print(repr(g['read']()))
del b[key]
try:
    g['read']()
except NameError as error:
    print(repr((type(error).__name__, str(error), error.name)))
b[key] = saved
print(repr(g['read']() == saved))
rows.expected:
42
('NameError', "name '__name__' is not defined", '__name__')
True

oracle.stdout:
42
('NameError', "name '__name__' is not defined", '__name__')
True

rows.actual:
42
('NameError', "name '__name__' is not defined", '__name__')
True
